name: streambox-debian12-base
notes: Initial Streambox Debian 12 product selector. Installs only the scoped Amlogic GStreamer pieces needed for GE2D conversion, V4L2 decode, and Wave521 encode; vfmcap GStreamer capture, gst-manager, one-kvm, Cockpit plugins, and remaining streambox-tv components remain outside this package group until their sources are inventoried and branched.
